findings.title: Notice and Apology Regarding Customer Information Affected Through Unauthorized Access (Capcom IR)
findings.summary_md: Capcom published an official notice and apology stating that a third party gained unauthorized access to its CAPCOM ID online membership service. The company detected suspicious activity on October 19, 2026 and immediately began blocking access while investigating the cause and scope. The notice covers 11,774,247 CAPCOM ID records worldwide, including names, addresses, phone numbers, email addresses, dates of birth, and gameplay data, with login passwords changed on 196 accounts. Capcom states no credit card information was compromised and urges users to watch for phishing attempts.
